section_summary.extract_value: This section presents the results of a principal-axis factor analysis of the BAS-2 (Body Appreciation Scale-2) instrument. The analysis indicated adequate factorability (Bartlett's test p < .001, KMO = .93) and revealed that a single factor should be extracted, with an eigenvalue of 5.69 explaining 56.89% of total variance. All 10 BAS-2 items loaded onto this single factor with fair to excellent factor loadings.
